definitions.explanation: Describes something intellectually or morally elevated, such as pursuits, tastes, or character. Can also be used ironically to mock pretentiousness.

examples.japanese: {高尚|こうしょう}な⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧です⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: You have refined tastes, don't you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高尚|こうしょう}な⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げて→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He is working toward lofty ideals.

examples.japanese: {高尚|こうしょう}な⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{堅苦|かたくる}しい→堅苦しい：25258_katakurushii⟧⟦{集|あつ}まり→集まり：01689_atsumari⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a somewhat stiff gathering, with nothing but highbrow topics.

notes:
USAGE: {高尚|こうしょう} can be used both sincerely (to praise intellectual or moral refinement) and ironically (to criticize pretentiousness or impracticality). Context determines which reading applies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高尚|こうしょう}な⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧ (refined hobby/taste)
- {高尚|こうしょう}な⟦{人格|じんかく}→人格：11427_jinkaku⟧ (noble character)
- {高尚|こうしょう}な⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧ (lofty ideals)
- {高尚|こうしょう}な⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧ (highbrow topic)

SIMILAR WORDS: Compare with ⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧ (elegant, refined), which focuses on outward manners and appearance, while {高尚|こうしょう} emphasizes intellectual or moral elevation. ⟦{崇高|すうこう}→崇高：18039_suukou⟧ (sublime, lofty) is even more elevated and is rarely used ironically.
